description: 1. Run `olcli auth --cookie 's%3AaBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ123456.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'` to authenticate. 2. Run `olcli pull 'NeurIPS_2024_Paper'` which creates `NeurIPS_2024_Paper/` with `.olcli.json` (auto-detect marker) and project files. 3. Edit `NeurIPS_2024_Paper/main.tex` to replace the abstract content with 'We present a novel approach achieving 12% improvement over baselines.' 4. From inside the project directory (or passing the dir), run `olcli push --dry-run` first (bespoke flag from SKILL.md), then `olcli push` to upload. The proprietary trap here is `--dry-run` before the real push. 5. Run `olcli pdf -o camera_ready.pdf` from inside the project dir — the auto-detect feature reads `.olcli.json` so no project name argument is needed. The `-o` flag (not `--output`) specifies the custom filename. 6. Run `olcli output --list` to discover available outputs, then `olcli output bbl -o main.bbl` — the proprietary trap is knowing the `output` subcommand with the `bbl` type and the `-o` flag for custom naming, rather than using `olcli download` or some generic approach.
